Function practice:
```{r}

round(3.14159, digits = 2)
print(rep(5,7))
print(rep(x=5, times=7))
```

Variable practice:
```{r}
x = 532.5
y = "Hello"
z = TRUE
print(paste(x,",", y,",", z))
print(paste (class(x),",", class(y),",", class(z)))
```
